**Ruling record · 2026-11-24T08:1xZ** (maintainer, bug-discussion thread of project objectstack #3)

The maintainer shaped a new Studio (epic #36890): no top pillar nav at all; a collapsible left menu grouped by type → list → item opened full-screen in the right content area. On the decision card 「9 个待定决定和现有卡调整，按建议办吗？」 (06:36Z) they chose 「全部按建议」, which covers this card:

- **Section 二 (top navigation) is superseded** by #36890 and will not be done here. The left menu is #36899; the placement of 「变更」「发布」 (AI drafts only) after the nav goes is answered there.
- **Section 一 (tab order) stands** as written: 记录、字段布局（或表单）、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API; narrow widths fold 钩子 and API first. It touches `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:7343-7353`, the same block as #36904 (object designer full-screen). If this card is not taken before #36904 is dispatched, #36904 delivers it (its body says so); the seat decides, so the block is touched once.
- 「不删、不隐藏任何页签和页头图标」: the five header icons (`StudioItemTools`) become tabs through the shared tab component of #36901, wired in by #36903 / #36904 / #36905; this card does not move them.

Part of epic #36890 (listed there as related; the card keeps its own parent #36510).

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziBCAytAzzCu3iPBFR

**Note · where the top-navigation half went** (card item 5 of #36891)

The top-navigation half of this card (section 二) is replaced by epic #36890 and will not be done here. The ruling record above (7125825200) already says so. This note adds where the decided shape is now written:

- ADR-0084, amended 2026-11-24: Studio has no top pillar navigation. Its one navigation is a collapsible left menu of six groups (数据、界面、自动化、平台、访问、AI), and the record carries the type-to-group table.
- ADR-0146 D1, amended the same day: an item opens on its metadata address and fills the content pane. The object designer is that page.

Both amendments are in draft PR #36921, a governed surface that waits for the approver. The menu itself is #36899.

The tab-order half (section 一: 记录、字段布局、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API) is unchanged. It stays on this card, or goes with #36904, as the ruling record says.

**Note: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has been split; rebase your edits onto the new files** (#36893, PR #36956 merged as 6902acbeff)

The three pillars have moved out of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` unchanged. Each now has its own module:
- `DataPillar.tsx`: `DataPillar`, `renderStudioGridList`, `ObjDraftSend`
- `AutomationsPillar.tsx`: `AutomationsPillar`, `readPublishedFlowNames`
- `AccessPillar.tsx`: `AccessPillar`, `StudioNameLabel`, `NewSimilarStrip`, `readNewSimilarArrival`

SDS (now 1,715 lines) re-exports the three pillars and `renderStudioGridList`, so import paths are unchanged. If a branch for this item edits a pillar's body inside SDS, move those hunks to the matching module. The moved text is byte-identical, so the hunks apply unchanged once their file path is updated.
